title: Oversight of the Constitutionality of Laws in the Jordanian Political System: A Comparative Study
core_idea: A comparative, descriptive study that aims to identify the extent to which the constitutionality of laws is applied in the Jordanian political system by reviewing types of oversight in political and judicial domains and by examining the implications of the 2011 constitutional amendments that established the Constitutional Court, with comparisons to oversight mechanisms in the US, France (international level) and Egypt (regional level).
tldr: Examines how constitutional review of laws functions in Jordan after the 2011 amendments creating a Constitutional Court, through descriptive comparison with US, France and Egypt focusing on political and judicial oversight.
